_readme: Edit this file, save it as config.json, then run: python homepulse.py
_tips: Use your cameras' SUB-STREAM for the live view (lower res = far lighter, faster).
Cameras: 'scale' is the width sent to the browser (640 is plenty on a phone).
Hosts: set 'ssh' to get uptime/RAM/disk; set 'shutdown' to allow power-off; set 'mac' to allow Wake-on-LAN.
Change 'password' to something strong, or set env HOMEPULSE_PASSWORD.
title: HomePulse

hosts.name: Home Server
hosts.warn: This runs HomePulse itself — powering off takes the dashboard down.
